versions.content: Limitations on DemMemoryDestinationRef A DTC can only reference the event memories via DemMemoryDestinationRef to the event memories of the same DemEventMemorySet . The scenario that a DTC references event memories via DemMemoryDestinationRef on different DemEventMemorySet is not supported.
